title: Job Interviews
completion_message: ¡Contratado! Estás listo para enfrentar entrevistas de trabajo en inglés con total confianza.

parts.visual:
El candidato ideal: 
- Candidate / Applicant (Candidato). 
- Background (Experiencia previa / Antecedentes). 
- Strengths and Weaknesses (Fortalezas y debilidades). 
Ej: What are your greatest strengths? (¿Cuáles son tus mayores fortalezas?).
parts.audio: The ideal candidate. Candidate or Applicant means the person applying for the job. Background refers to your past experience and education. Strengths are things you are good at, and weaknesses are things you need to improve. For example: What are your greatest strengths?

parts.visual:
El proceso: 
- Recruit (Reclutar). 
- Hire (Contratar). 
- Fire / Let go (Despedir). 
- Resign (Renunciar). 
Ej: We want to hire a new software engineer next month.
parts.audio: The process. Recruit means to find new people to join a company. Hire means to give someone a job. Fire or let go means to terminate someone's employment. Resign means to quit your job voluntarily. For example: We want to hire a new software engineer.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la palabra de Recursos Humanos correcta.

questions.question: Could you tell me about your educational ____? (Experiencia / Antecedentes).
We interviewed five ____ for the position. (Candidatos).
We decided to ____ him because of his excellent resume. (Contratar).
Unfortunately, the company had to ____ 50 employees. (Despedir).
questions.explanation: Fire = despedir (también se usa 'lay off' si es por recorte de personal).

questions.question: He decided to ____ from his job to travel the world. (Renunciar).
questions.explanation: Resign = renunciar voluntariamente. Retire es jubilarse.

questions.question: Why do you want to work for this ____? (Empresa).
I have five years of ____ in marketing. (Experiencia).
She is the best ____ for the job. (Solicitante / Candidato).
questions.explanation: Applicant = solicitante (el que aplica al trabajo).

questions.question: Please attach your ____ to the email. (Currículum).
They are going to ____ new graduates from the university. (Reclutar).
I am looking for a full-time ____. (Puesto / Posición).
Do you have any ____ for me? (Preguntas).
questions.explanation: En entrevistas siempre preguntan: Do you have any questions for us?

questions.question: I am a quick ____ and I adapt easily. (Aprendiz).
questions.explanation: Quick learner = alguien que aprende rápido.

questions.question: We offer excellent benefits and health ____. (Seguro).
Are you willing to ____? (Mudarte / Trasladarte de ciudad).
We will ____ you next week with our decision. (Contactar).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe la palabra de entrevista correcta.

questions.question: We want to ____ you. (Contratar con H)
The best ____ for the job. (Candidato con C)

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la pregunta/frase de entrevista.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Could you tell me about your background?
options: Could you tell me about your background?
Can you tell me about your background?
Could you talk about your background?
Would you tell me about your background?
questions.correct_answer: Could you tell me about your background?

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: She decided to resign from her job.
options: She decided to resign from her job.
He decided to resign from his job.
She decides to resign from her job.
They decided to resign from the job.
questions.correct_answer: She decided to resign from her job.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Do you have any questions for me?
options: Do you have any questions for me?
Do you have any questions for us?
Do you have a question for me?
Does she have any questions for me?
questions.correct_answer: Do you have any questions for me?

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: We will contact you next week.
options: We will contact you next week.
I will contact you next week.
They will contact you next week.
questions.correct_answer: We will contact you next week.
